resources.name: Wraith Form Rounds
resources.description: Rounds per day equal Wraith level + casting ability modifier. Activate as a move action and end as a free action.

resources.name: Possession Active
resources.description: Track passive or active possession. Active and unwilling passive possession normally cost 1 spell point.

resources.name: Possession / Haunt DC
resources.description: 10 + half Wraith level + casting ability modifier.

choice_providers.label: Haunt Path
choice_providers.description: Choose one haunt path permanently. It grants its sphere, staged possession options, and a half-level path-skill bonus.

choice_providers.label: Wraith Haunts
choice_providers.description: Choose one qualifying wraith haunt at every odd level from 3rd through 19th.

notes: The corrected Mid-Caster profile feeds shared CL, talent, and spell-point systems; wraith form, possession, path, and nine haunts are explicit.
